_meta.description: Lender registry: licence status + regulator/court findings. Each fact carries a source and date. Facts only, no unsourced accusations.
_meta.cbk_dcp_list_note: Licence status reflects CBK's published Digital Credit Providers list. DCP licensing applies to app-based digital lenders; asset financiers and microfinance banks are licensed under different regimes (noted per lender).

lenders.name: M-KOPA
lenders.regime: Not a CBK-DCP; PAYG asset financier (device secured against itself).

findings.summary: PAYG devices are remotely locked if a payment is missed; under scrutiny over hidden costs of the daily-payment model.
Financing is secured against the handset, which is 'locked' if payments cease.
Boda-boda BNPL model criticised for saddling riders with expensive debt; repossession on default.
CAK found Mogo Auto in violation of the Competition Act for false and misleading representations and unconscionable conduct in its loan products.
Repossession over small arrears documented; tracker used to disable/locate the bike.
Collateral vehicle (KCN 925C) was registered in the lender's joint name and enforced via court process, illustrating asset-seizure exposure in secured microfinance.

lenders.name: QuickCash (unlicensed app, demo)
lenders.regime: App-based digital lender. NOT on CBK's licensed DCP list (illustrative demo lender).

findings.summary: Kenyan court blocked unlicensed digital lenders from enforcing repayment; an unlicensed lender may not be able to lawfully pursue a borrower.
